user.title: Connect to the matrix
user.description: The matrix does not report its own model, so choose it here. Another controller may already be connected — that is fine, the hardware accepts several at once.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the matrix.
data_description.port: TCP control port. The default suits every model.
data_description.model: Determines how many inputs and outputs exist.

channels.title: Choose the channels in use
channels.description: Clear anything that is not wired up. Unused channels can be enabled later without losing the ones already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to re-read the matrix. It does not announce changes, so anything altered by another controller appears at the next poll.

error.cannot_connect: No Triad matrix answered. Check the address and that TCP port 52000 is reachable.

abort.already_configured: This matrix is already set up.

init.title: Channels and limits
init.description: Enable the channels in use, cap any zone that should not be driven to full, and set how often the matrix is polled.

data_description.scan_interval: Lower values notice another controller's changes sooner, at the cost of more traffic.

audio_sense_disabled.title: Audio sense is switched off on {matrix}
audio_sense_disabled.description:
You have enabled audio-sense entities for **{matrix}**, but the matrix is not measuring, so they will stay unavailable.

The device reports the same value for "no audio" and "not measuring", so this cannot be shown as simply off without asserting something the hardware has not determined.

**This is not changed in Home Assistant.** The setting lives in the Control4 driver for this matrix: set `SET_DISABLE_AUDIO_SENSE` to `DISABLED = false`. Changing it on the device instead does not last -- the driver re-asserts its own value every time it reconnects.

If you did not intend to use audio sense, disable those entities and this will clear.

set_eq_band.name: Set EQ band
set_eq_band.description: Set a band's frequency, gain and Q together. Omitted values are left alone, and the band is re-read once at the end rather than after each parameter.

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.description: Centre frequency in Hz. Snapped to the nearest band the matrix offers.

q.name: Q
q.description: Band Q. The matrix offers 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1, 2 and 3.

send_raw.name: Send raw command
send_raw.description: Send one protocol command and return the reply. For reading something the integration does not model yet.

command.name: Command
command.description: Hex, starting FF 55. For example FF5504031EF500 reads output 1's volume.

allow_write.name: Allow writing
allow_write.description: Required for any command without the F5 query marker. Those change the device, and it accepts out-of-range writes silently, so this is off by default.
